handover_cancel_reason_cancelled.name: handover_cancel_reason_cancelled
handover_cancel_reason_cancelled.value: "handover"."cancel_reason" is null or "handover"."cancelled_at" is not null

parcel_delivery_check.name: parcel_delivery_check
parcel_delivery_check.value: ("parcel"."status" = 'remis') = ("parcel"."delivered_at" is not null and "parcel"."delivered_by" is not null)

parcel_pieces_check.name: parcel_pieces_check
parcel_pieces_check.value: ("parcel"."piece_n" is null or "parcel"."piece_n" >= 1) and ("parcel"."piece_total" is null or ("parcel"."piece_total" >= 1 and ("parcel"."piece_n" is null or "parcel"."piece_n" <= "parcel"."piece_total")))

parcel_damage_check.name: parcel_damage_check
parcel_damage_check.value: ("parcel"."damage" is null or "parcel"."damage" in ('carton_abime', 'ouvert', 'mouille', 'contenu_casse', 'autre')) and ("parcel"."damage" is null) = ("parcel"."damaged_at" is null)

parcel_reply_check.name: parcel_reply_check
parcel_reply_check.value: ("parcel"."reply" is null or "parcel"."reply" in ('not_mine', 'colleague', 'absent')) and ("parcel"."reply" is null) = ("parcel"."replied_at" is null)
